title: Tech delay cascades into an FDP breach

event.narrative: VT-DXA has a 90-minute technical delay before DX401 on 16 Sep. All four legs shift by 90 minutes.

options.action: Original crew operates DX401–DX403 (delayed); full reserve set (CPT, FO, SCC, 3 CC) operates DX404
options.reasoning: Delayed 3-leg duty FDP 9.5h vs 12.5h limit — legal. Reserve set covers the last sector (callout window and 12h-rest all satisfied).
Legal but ~3.3x more expensive than re-crewing one leg; 162 passengers stranded.

changed.detail: RULE-FDP-01: delayed duty runs 12.75h vs 12.0h limit (4 sectors) — the rostered crew cannot legally complete DX404.
